$comment: Working examples shown by PagePreview's `example` entry, exported as Markdown and copied by the registry. Each example is a folder: `index.html` is the markup a page holds, `main.js` an ES module whose `mount(root)` starts it and returns the function that stops it, and `files` anything else it imports, such as its data. `contracts` names the Master UI contracts it uses and `dependencies` the packages it needs beyond @master/css and @master/ui, at the exact versions the site installs. Third-party engines are the site's dependencies only, never @master/ui's.

table-view.title: Table view
table-view.description: Search, filter, sort, select and page through a workspace's projects, people and files, all on local data.

filter-bar.title: Filter bar
filter-bar.description: Conditions on a field, an operator and a value: staged, applied, shown as chips and counted.

activity-feed.title: Activity feed
activity-feed.description: What happened to a project, grouped by time, with who did it and what it touched.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: A conversation on local data: grouped messages, attachments, delivery state, reactions and a composer.

schedule-view.title: Schedule view
schedule-view.description: A team calendar by the day, the week, the month or as an agenda, with each event's details.

rich-text.title: Rich text editor
rich-text.description: Tiptap in the editor frame: a fixed toolbar, the document as JSON, and its states.

chart-dashboard.title: Chart dashboard
chart-dashboard.description: Figures, stacked areas, a donut and a ranking under one choice of period, each chart written again from the period's numbers.

image-adjustments.title: Image adjustments
image-adjustments.description: Choose a local picture, crop and turn it, and set its brightness, contrast and saturation; hand on the original file and the adjustments as data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: An inquiry form beside the ways to reach the team: native validation, errors after the reader has tried, and the result in place.

file-upload.title: File upload
file-upload.description: Choose or drop files, then follow each one: waiting, uploading, done, failed or refused, with cancel, retry and remove. The progress is a timer.

preview.bodyClass: flex items-center justify-center p-lg bg-surface-base fg-text-body text-sm min-h(736)

password-reset-request.title: Password reset: ask for a link
password-reset-request.description: One email field and its result, which reads the same whether or not an account has the address.

preview.bodyClass: flex items-center justify-center p-lg bg-surface-tray fg-text-body text-sm min-h(520)

password-reset-new.title: Password reset: choose a new password
password-reset-new.description: A new password and its confirmation, held to each other by the browser, and the result once they agree.

preview.bodyClass: flex items-center justify-center p-lg bg-surface-tray fg-text-body text-sm min-h(520)

notification-inbox.title: Notification inbox
notification-inbox.description: Six notifications in a page: all or unread, read one by one or all at once, and what shows when nothing is unread.

results.title: Results
results.description: Twelve resources to search, narrow by type, sort and page through, as cards or a list.

multi-step.title: Multi-step task
multi-step.description: A workspace set up in three steps on local memory: details, preferences and a review.

board.title: Board
board.description: Twelve cards in four columns, moved by the kanban behavior, with counts read from the arrangement.

pane-preference.title: File list width
pane-preference.description: Keep a completed resize across visits and restore the last saved width after an interrupted drag.

session-request.title: Find and correct form errors
session-request.description: Submit the empty request and follow the second error to the start date. The range takes two dates, with the end on or after the start. Choose a studio visit to make an entrance code required. Switching back to remote keeps the draft code while excluding it from validation and submission.

rename-record.title: Correct a rejected name
rename-record.description: Rename the recording to Harbor to replay a duplicate-name response from the local fixture. The saved name remains visible below. The rejected spelling stays in the field so it can be corrected or canceled.

password-visibility.title: Read back a password
password-visibility.description: Type a sample password and toggle its visibility. The same native field keeps the value, selection and autocomplete hint. Pointer activation while typing keeps the caret in the field. Keyboard users can operate the toggle in its own tab stop.

recording-search.title: Compose a query before searching
recording-search.description: Type 台北 with an input method, or replay the two local scenarios. The first sends Enter during composition. The second returns the earlier search for 台 after the search for 台北. Only the current result can be selected.

recent-commands.title: Clear recent commands and return focus
recent-commands.description: Open the palette and clear its recent commands. The clear button sits beside the results. After it disappears, the search field receives focus and the remaining command can be run with the keyboard.

recording-list.title: Empty search and a first collection
recording-list.description: Search for an absent title in the read-only and full workspaces. Clear the search or inspect usage. Switch to First visit to add a sample recording. Reload shows the same rows while loading. Removed recordings can be restored together.

sequential-upload.title: Follow a sequential batch
sequential-upload.description: Start the five local sample files. The progress bar measures the current file and the live text announces the file number when it changes. Cancel ends the batch and reports how many files completed. Start again to replay it.

report-tables.title: Read chart values in a table
report-tables.description: Open either data table. Each disclosure names its report, and each value has a site row heading and a month column heading. Both presentations read from the same series, including a measured zero.

unscheduled-recordings.title: Schedule a task that has no date
unscheduled-recordings.description: Tasks with confirmed dates appear on the timeline. A task waiting for a date stays in the adjacent list with its owner. Give the microphone check a date in the displayed week and follow it to the matching day.

canceled-session.title: Keep a canceled session on the agenda
canceled-session.description: Open either session for its details. The canceled session retains its original time and gives its status in the visible button name, so readers can distinguish it in monochrome and from a list of controls.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: A document being edited between its navigation and its properties, in a shell that is the viewport.
